products.title: Experiencing Grounded Theory: A Comprehensive Guide to Learning, Doing, Mentoring, Teaching, and Applying Grounded Theory
products.description: About the Author Odis E. Simmons was one of the earliest grounded theory students of Barney Glaser and Anselm Strauss, the originators of grounded theory. Both served on his dissertation committee, with Strauss as Chair. In 1971 he began teaching grounded theory to graduate students referred to him by Glaser & Strauss. He has since taught, mentored, and advised countless grounded theory students in academic and non-academic professional settings. He was awarded his Ph.D. in sociology, in 1974, from the University of California San Francisco. He held faculty positions at The University of Tulsa (Sociology), Yale University (Director of Self-Care Program, Medical School, Department of Public Health), and Fielding Graduate University (Educational Leadership), where he developed a doctoral specialty in grounded theory. He focused his career on teaching grounded theory to anyone who wanted to learn and devising ways of using it for applied purposes. He created two grounded theory applied methods, grounded action and grounded therapy, which he refined and fully tested during 14 years as a counselor/therapist for a non-profit social agency. He was a close protégé of both Glaser and Strauss until their passing.

top_reviews.title: My new favorite behind-the-scenes, all-in-one guide to classic grounded theory
top_reviews.text: I am a researcher a couple years out from the completion of my dissertation using classic grounded theory. Though I was extremely lucky to have a fantastic grounded theory mentor (trained by Dr. Simmons, in fact), I am well aware of many of the challenges of learning and doing classic grounded theory in a graduate institution. I can honestly say that I loved every single page of this book! It is the book I wish I had during my graduate program to compliment Glaser’s brilliant but difficult books on classic grounded theory. Grounded theory is such an experiential research method, and I learn more about it every time I read more about it or do more of it. This book brought me some of the most profound insights I’ve had on the CGT process all in one place! It cleared up things I never completely understood and helped me to feel more confident in my abilities and research process. Dr. Simmons talks to the reader as a respected and trusted mentee in clear language and with a belief that it’s possible for anymore (or at least most people) to learn and do good grounded theory. He writes about many of his own personal experiences with Glaser and Strauss and gives one of the best descriptions I've read on the origins of classic grounded theory. He also offers some clear counterpoints to the “CGT is objectivist” argument, and I wish I had been able to use these in my own dissertation defense. When I finished the book, I felt like I understood the methodology better and I felt more confident and energized to dive back into my research. This is absolutely a book I will be reading multiple times and that I would recommend to any grounded theory student, teacher, or research-curious person.

top_reviews.title: By Far the Best Explanation of Grounded Theory
top_reviews.text: What incredible insight to add a glossary at the beginning of the book!  And it only gets better.  Dr. Simmons has provided a clear and concise explanation of grounded theory with both content and examples.  I would suggest reading Dr. Simmons' book before delving into Glaser and Strauss' books.  Also I caution people to be aware that there are different types of grounded theory and people should be careful which authors are read because several authors use a variant of grounded theory which was not Glaser's intention.  Simmons'  book follows Glaser's precepts and is the original type of grounded theory; it is the one that uses Glaser's method.  Another bonus to Simmons' book is that he discusses Grounded Action - developed by Odis Simmons  - it is the application of grounded theory to implement practical actions for change.

dialogue.user: Those reviews are helpful, thank you. I have a couple of questions: Does the book focus mostly on academic research, or could someone outside academia—maybe in a workplace or practical setting—also benefit from it? And is there anything unique about its educational approach that sets "Experiencing Grounded Theory: A Comprehensive Guide to Learning, Doing, Mentoring, Teaching, and Applying Grounded Theory" apart from similar books?
dialogue.agent:
"Experiencing Grounded Theory: A Comprehensive Guide to Learning, Doing, Mentoring, Teaching, and Applying Grounded Theory" is not limited to academic research—it’s designed for graduate students, experienced researchers, and practicing professionals who want to use grounded theory in practical, real-world contexts as well. The author devotes specific chapters to "grounded action" and "grounded therapy," offering applied, step-by-step methods and real examples from his professional, non-academic work, such as anger management and counseling programs.

What sets this book apart is its comprehensive yet accessible approach: it features a glossary to help all readers (not just academics) become familiar with terminology, dedicates an entire chapter to practical exercises and application, and includes teaching models for both university and workplace training. Reviewers emphasize its clarity, helpful examples, and the author’s ability to make complex concepts approachable for a variety of audiences.

Would you like to proceed with the purchase or need more information?

result.title: Experiencing Grounded Theory: A Comprehensive Guide to Learning, Doing, Mentoring, Teaching, and Applying Grounded Theory
result.features: This book is a comprehensive, intelligible guide to grounded theory with a focus on classic grounded theory. It will be useful for graduate students, experienced researchers, and practicing professionals who want to use the method for practical purposes. It will also be useful for mentors and teachers of grounded theory. A glossary is included in the preface so readers can familiarize themselves with grounded theory terminology before beginning the chapters. Its seven chapters provide a comprehensive guide to grounded theory. Chapter one covers how the author's familiarity with the symbolic interactionist perspective gained from his undergraduate sociology professors enabled him to readily discern how and why Glaser and Strauss had different understandings about grounded theory and what those differences were. Chapter two discusses the uniqueness of grounded theory in relation to other methods and the differences between classic and constructivist grounded theory. Chapter three provides practical tips for selecting and working with a dissertation or thesis committee for grounded theory. The longest chapter, Chapter four, is a detailed, step-by-step guide for learning and doing every stage of the classic grounded theory process, with examples and exercises. Chapter five discusses "grounded action," a multi-step applied grounded theory method devised by the author. It includes how he used it to develop a unique grounded anger management program. Chapter Six discusses "grounded therapy," another applied grounded theory method the author devised for conducting counseling/therapy, with examples. Chapter Seven presents grounded theory teaching models for undergraduate and graduate students. WORDS OF PRAISE This book is an indispensable well to new insights and creative ideas on how to understand, teach, and apply classic grounded theory. A ground-breaking resource for students, teachers and professional practitioners across fields. Excitingly well-written and humorous, with complex issues made easily accessible to anyone interested in the method. ---Astrid Gynnild, Professor, University of Bergen, Norway and previous Editor of Grounded Theory Review Odis Simmons is the foremost expert in the world on teaching grounded theory. His vast knowledge of the method, which was once only available to his students and mentees, is now available to researchers worldwide in Experiencing Grounded Theory. It is a must-read for anyone who wants an in-depth understanding of how to conduct, apply, or teach grounded theory. ---Kara L. Vander Linden, Founder & President of the Board, Institute for Research & Theory Methodologies, Glaser Center for Grounded Theory I highly recommend Odis' book to anyone wishing to learn how to do grounded theory; how to apply a grounded theory to practice; and how to communicate grounded theory to doctoral committees and ethical review boards. This authoritative book is written with warmth and humour, littered with helpful examples and is grounded in decades of using the method and teaching grounded theory to people like us. ---Helen Scott, Founder of Grounded Theory Online, Fellow of Grounded Theory Institute, Reviewer of Grounded Theory Review
